'''Nekoflare''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Flameow]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Silversear]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Rarely approaches Tatari other than [[Nekowatt]], though there are records of Nekoflare using flames to warm a fallen Tatari in the snow. Nekoflare would never admit it, though."

Nekoflare is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A dark gray-blue cat that wears a red- and white-striped bow around its waist. Similar to a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maneki-neko maneki-neko], Nekoflare usually raises one paw while resting the other on an orange orb with a flame symbol on it. Its inner ears and the end of its long tail are fiery red. It also has yellow and orange paws, yellow eyes with red pupils, and the a white lower face.

Nekoflare's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with bright pink, and its gray-blue fur becomes gray-teal. Additionally, its front paws become white and pink instead of yellow and orange.

== Evolution Trial ==
Nekoflare's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Silversear]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Nekoflare to increase stats 3 times.
* In [[Island Gold Rush]] use 5,000 energy drinks.

==Strategy==
[[File:Nekoflare Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Nekoflare's attack range]]
You should use [[Kittazap]]/evo alongside Nekoflare because of the Paw Pals bond.
{{clear|left}}
